title: Artifact Activation Definitions
description: Maps legacy activation IDs to composition-based effect chains. Preserves all original activation names while replacing hardcoded behavior with parameterized effects.

activation_id.description: The legacy uppercase activation name used in artifacts.json. Must not be changed.

description.description: Lore-appropriate description shown to the player.

effects.description: Ordered list of effects applied when this activation fires. Effects are applied in sequence.

notes.description: Implementation notes for developers. Not shown to players.
